[[Marc Thompson]]{{tt|*|Pokémon Mystery Dungeon: Explorers of Sky - Beyond Time and Darkness}}| java1=[[Daisuke Sakaguchi]]| }} '''Chatot''' (Japanese: '''ペラップ''' ''Perap'') is a [[non-player character]] in {{g|Mystery Dungeon: Explorers of Time and Explorers of Darkness}} and {{g|Mystery Dungeon: Explorers of Sky}}. ==In the games== He is the head of intelligence of the guild and {{mdc|Wigglytuff|2}}'s second-in-command, as well as his best friend. Chatot assigns explorations to the [[Wigglytuff's Guild|guild members]] and is in charge when Wigglytuff falls asleep. He's very old friends with Wigglytuff and, level-wise, is the second most powerful member of the guild. Although he means well, he can be somewhat hotheaded. His personality is also somewhat erratic, but to a lesser extent than Wigglytuff. Though he always has the Guild's best intentions at heart, he's known to be rather harsh, such as sending the {{pkmn2|hero}} and [[Partner Pokémon (Mystery Dungeon)|partner]] to bed without dinner for failing a mission without allowing them to explain themselves. He is somewhat paranoid, mostly about Wigglytuff getting mad, and sleeps at the top of the ladder out of the guild to ensure no one runs away. He is shown to care deeply for the Guild members, but will sometimes deny it, claiming his actions are for the Guild's best interests. He, like most everyone, fell for {{mdc|Dusknoir|2}}'s lies and had a lot of respect for him, shown by how much convincing it took for him to believe the team's story after they escape the future. Chatot accompanies the hero and their partner during the [[Brine Cave]] exploration, up until the relay point, where he angrily chases {{mdc|Team Skull}}, after they stole the partner's [[Relic Fragment]] and Chatot discovered how much trouble they'd caused the team as well as being mad for being tricked by them. After reprimanding the wounded Team Skull, he heads forward, and when the hero and partner spot him, he protects them and takes a powerful attack from {{p|Kabutops}} and the {{p|Omastar}} brothers in their defense, much like before, where he explored the same dungeon with Wigglytuff and was attacked in the same manner, taking the hit for Wigglytuff. After the team defeats the Fossil Pokémon, the guild takes Chatot back to the guild to tend to his wounds. After the credits roll, in the team's [[Mystifying Forest]] exploration, he plays as one of the "minions" of "the grand master of all things bad," for the team's graduation exam. Despite the team discovering the truth, thanks to Bidoof, the guild denies it to no end. After the hero and the partner adopt Manaphy, Chatot will give advice about caring for the water type but then he later has Walrein come and raise Manaphy at the sea, in its natural habitat after Manaphy gets sick. During [[Super Mystery Dungeon]], Chatot's quest can only be unlocked once the player has connected with Bidoof and Loudred. His quest has him accompany the player's team in searching for [[Wigglytuff (Explorers of Time, Darkness, and Sky)|Wigglytuff]], who has gotten lost again in a dungeon. Upon Wigglytuff's rescue, the pair will connect with the player and will be selectable. ===Moves used=== In [[Mystifying Forest]] and [[Bidoof's Wish]], Chatot is guaranteed to know {{m|Hyper Voice}}.
